clauses.heading: Retention duration of Confidentiality
clauses.text:
Retention duration of Confidentiality
The Employee agrees that all obligations regarding the confidentiality and non-disclosure of the Employer’s proprietary,
confidential, or trade secret information shall survive the termination of employment for a period of three (3) years.
During this period, the Employee shall not disclose, use, or permit the use of any such confidential information for any
purpose other than as expressly authorized in writing by the Employer.
clauses.plain_english: The employee must keep the company's confidential information secret for three years after their employment ends and cannot use it without written permission.
clauses.risk_justification: The confidentiality obligation has a defined three-year expiration period, which is standard industry practice and not perpetual.

summary.executive_summary: This document is a hybrid Internship Agreement and Non-Disclosure Agreement between Neutrinos Software Services Pvt Ltd and Mohan Chandra S S for an SDE Intern position based in Bangalore. The agreement outlines a 10-week internship starting March 2, 2026, with a commitment of 15 hours per week. It incorporates strict confidentiality obligations aligned with ISO 27001 and SOC 2 standards, which survive for three years post-termination. The contract allows for termination by either party with 7 days' written notice.
key_points: Internship duration is 10 weeks starting March 2, 2026, with a 15-hour weekly commitment.
Confidentiality obligations survive for three years following the termination of the internship.
Either party may terminate the agreement with 7 days' written notice.
The intern is required to comply with ISO 27001 and SOC 2 security standards.
Upon successful completion, the intern will receive an Internship Completion Letter.
The intern must return or destroy all confidential information upon termination or request.
red_flags: The agreement lacks explicit compensation details, which may violate the Code on Wages in India.
There is no mention of dispute resolution mechanisms or a specific governing law clause, creating ambiguity in legal enforcement.
The document is missing mandatory statutory benefits information required under Indian labour laws, such as POSH compliance or leave entitlements.
favorable_clauses: The 7-day notice period for termination is mutual, providing flexibility for both the employer and the intern.
The provision for an Internship Completion Letter provides a tangible benefit to the intern upon successful performance.
unusual_clauses: The document contains fragmented text and repetitive headers (e.g., Section 2.1, 2.2, 2.3) suggesting potential formatting errors or incomplete drafting.
The inclusion of specific ISO 27001 and SOC 2 compliance requirements for an intern is highly rigorous and atypical for standard internship agreements.
recommended_actions: Request a formal compensation schedule to ensure compliance with the Code on Wages.
Clarify the governing law and jurisdiction to ensure the contract is enforceable under Indian law.
Incorporate a formal Dispute Resolution clause to define how disagreements will be settled.
Ensure the intern receives a copy of the company's POSH policy and other mandatory workplace regulations.
Review the document for formatting errors and ensure all sections are complete and coherent before signing.
